about.label: About Us
about.heading: End-to-End Technology Partner
about.p1: Onetechmated Solutions is a full-spectrum technology company with deep expertise at the intersection of industrial automation and enterprise software. We don't just write code — we engineer systems that connect physical industrial operations with intelligent digital layers.
about.p2: Our team has hands-on experience with PLCs, SCADA, MQTT protocols, and Ignition engineering on the industrial side, while simultaneously building custom SaaS platforms, AI agents, IoT dashboards, and ERP systems on the IT side. This rare dual expertise is what sets us apart.
